title: Implement MARBLE MultiAgentBudgetOptimizer and pass the sealed suite
goal: Implement the MARBLE coding benchmark task MultiAgentBudgetOptimizer (task_id=50 in multiagentbench/coding/coding_main.jsonl at the pinned commit) as workspace/gc-329/solution.py per assets/gc-329/SPEC.md: multi-user expense tracking against planned category limits, group summaries, headroom-safe limit reallocation, and a deterministic overshoot-reduction optimizer. Plan the invariants first (limits precede spending, reallocation never strands spent amounts), implement in increments, and rerun the sealed suite after each increment while tracking red tests by name. Finish with a green re-verification inside the pinned container.

spec.command: python -m pip install -q pytest==8.3.3 && python -m pytest assets/gc-329/test_accept.py -q --tb=no -p no:cacheprovider

process_expectations: A plan artifact exists before coding that states the budget invariants and the optimizer's deterministic ordering rule
The sealed suite was executed after each increment with logs retained, including at least one red run before the final green
Red tests are tracked by pytest node id across iterations, not by count
Verification runs and their costs/outcomes are logged honestly, including failures
The sealed suite file is never edited; all recovery happens in workspace/gc-329/solution.py
